In conclusion, while a religious community offers a structured framework that can be highly effective, a group of respected individuals with shared values can also significantly influence personal growth. The effectiveness depends on the strength of shared values, community bonds, support levels, and individual commitment. The informal structure may offer flexibility but may also result in less consistent influence. Ultimately, the impact hinges on how actively one engages with the group and values their influence.
